rundown: Colonials beat Zips 76-73 at James A. Rhodes Arena in Akron, OH. Colonials led 34-27 at the half and held on. The 3rd quarter decided it: Colonials won it 22-15.
Leading the way — Colonials: Teigh Yeast 20 pts; Mackenzie Blackford 3 ast; Eva Levingston 7 reb. Zips: Shaena Brew 28 pts, 5 ast; Macey Fegan 12 reb.
Where Colonials won it: they shot 41% to 37%.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 20, 10:57 AM ET. It had Colonials 39% and Zips 61%, projecting Colonials 62.4 – Zips 66.1 (128.5 total, Zips by 3.8).

Final: Colonials 76 – Zips 73. Wrong winner: it had Zips at 61%, and Colonials (39%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Colonials came in with a 5% below average attack and a league-average defense (2-2, 66 scored and 62 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 161 and 160 games of evidence. Projected to score 62.4, they scored 76 (+13.6 points, 22% over); projected to allow 66.1, they allowed 73 (+6.9 points, 10% over).

Zips came in with a 4% below average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (1-4, 62.2 scored and 71.8 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 167 and 168 games of evidence. Projected to score 66.1, they scored 73 (+6.9 points, 10% over); projected to allow 62.4, they allowed 76 (+13.6 points, 22% over).

The bigger miss was Colonials' scoring (+13.6 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 149 against 128.5 projected (+20.5), about the 93rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Colonials by 3 against Zips by 3.8 projected, about the 30th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.128 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -5.5 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 802 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.973 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Colonials attack ×1.002, defense ×1.007 (5 games); Zips attack ×0.991, defense ×0.989 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
